mechanism: Garlic contains allicin and other compounds with antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that may potentiate bleeding risk, particularly relevant if piperacillin tazobactam causes thrombocytopenia or platelet dysfunction.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; consider advising patients on high-dose garlic supplementation to discuss with their healthcare provider, particularly if thrombocytopenia develops during antibiotic therapy.
